notes: Modified cash basis school district. Governmental funds statement Total Governmental Funds column (printed Exhibit III, trimmed p5-p12). The School Nutrition Fund and Activities Fund are shown inside the governmental funds statement, so there are no business-type lines (business_type null). Beginning cash = beginning fund balance 2,220,422.06 (p10). Check: 2,220,422.06 + 6,789,722.55 - 7,303,179.35 + 377,783.13 - 377,783.13 = 1,706,965.26. Printed Total Receipts (6,789,722.55) excludes the 377,783.13 transfers; Total Receipts and Other Financing Sources is 7,167,505.68. Non-Revenue Receipts 289,062.48 includes 250,000.00 'Allocation from General Fund' in the Depreciation Fund (Schedule C p18) with no matching general fund outflow on the statement; kept as printed and flagged for review. Balance sheet is the Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1); liabilities printed as 0.00 (empty list, total_liabilities 0). Detail: Schedule A (p14-15) for General Fund receipts, Schedule M (p19-27, by program and object) for General Fund expenditures; Schedule B (p16-17, by program) is the same fund's expenditures with less detail so it was not itemized; Schedule A-1 (p13) is a summary and skipped. Schedule A line 3599 State Categorical Grants (actual blank, budget 5,150) and Schedule M 1200 Other Items (actual blank, budget 40,481), 3535 purchased professional services (actual blank), not recorded since no actual is printed. Schedule M 'Other Items' lines are classed miscellaneous expenditure with review. In Schedule M the printed Total Disbursements 6,435,917.39 includes the 60,000.00 transfers (45,000 Activity Fund and Other; 15,000 School Nutrition Fund), recorded as other financing (-). In Schedule A the printed Total Receipts 6,392,414.26 includes the 317,783.13 transfer from other funds (other financing +). Read pages 1-27 of 27.
